room_id.$comment: T-17 V2.1 server-created room IDs are generated from 128 random bits and encoded as unpadded Base64URL, producing exactly 22 characters. This endpoint accepts those server-created IDs.

reference_solution.description: Optional internal-only reference source. It may be supplied only by execution-service from an authoritative, server-controlled source. Arbitrary client-provided reference code must never be trusted. Omit when no authoritative source is available. Never send this source to an external AI provider.
